title: 第15章 买买买第16章 东初山脉
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 她不是空想的人，立即翻开了功法，这本无属性的功法名字就叫《基础内法》，她发现学过炼气诀之后，功法大部分都能看懂了，炼气诀真不愧是入门基础。
巫未央反复看了几遍，确定没有看错什么后，才入定按照功法的描述开始运转灵力。
运转功法之后，巫未央的确知道要怎么使用灵力了，可这套功法真是对得起它的名字，只是教人粗暴地将灵力运用，没有任何婉转舒缓，连巫未央这种初入门的小白都能感受这功法的浅显简陋。
所以她学会之后就没再打算深读它，转而研究起剑谱来。
剑谱正是唐落天平常使用的那一套，巫未央早已看过千百次，但仔细看剑谱的描述，她又有了新的感悟，因为没有剑，便拿着竹萧照剑谱一招一式开始慢慢练起来。
一晃又是两个月过去，陈沫回来了。
他回来时巫未央正在练剑，见到她像模像样的剑法，陈沫有些诧异。
而巫未央见到陈沫迫不及待问道，“掌门，师兄他们进入大宗门了吗？”
陈沫被她打断，没再想她的剑法，眉梢略带喜意道，“你大师兄已经得以进去青云宗，苗苗去了紫天宗，景儿去了器衍宗。”
巫未央知道这几个宗门的威名，他们可是鸿蒙大陆的顶尖宗门，只是没想到师兄师姐们竟然分开去了不同的宗门。
对此，陈沫的说法是，青云宗剑道最为顶尖，唐落天决心走剑道自然选择青云宗，而紫天宗法修众多，柳苗苗去紫天宗也是最好的去处，崔景从一开始的目标就是器衍宗。
分不分开并不重要，这都是他们最好的路。
巫未央为他们感到高兴。
说完消息，陈沫又对巫未央说道，“现在朝天宗不再，你若没有去处可以留在这里，但是我有些事情，恐怕未来很长一段时间不会回来。”
巫未央早已有决定，“多谢掌门收留。”
陈沫瞧得出眼前这个小女孩的执拗，摇摇头去自己房屋取了东西后便离开了。
巫未央站在广场中央，看着他离去，重新执起竹箫。
一遍又一遍，寒来暑往，春去秋来，广场上那抹身影一点点抽条。
三年一晃而过，巫未央长高了，修为也高了，如今她已经是炼气六层修为。
五灵根当真是修炼得慢，纵使她日夜不休，三年也才涨了三层修为。
其实她的速度已经相当于三灵根的速度了。
这并非是她的灵根与寻常五灵根有所不同，而是她入定并不需要时间酝酿，寻常初入门的小孩也没有她这样的定力，能够坚持不休的修炼，这让巫未央的修炼时间几乎是别人的几倍。
不过这些巫未央都不清楚，她没有机会接触别的五灵根修士，只是心里觉得每每需要排去杂气实在浪费时间，耽误她修练。
巫未央心里还想着让体内灵气五行轮转的念头，三年来也做过不少尝试，不过都以失败告终。
又一次不厌其烦地清除体内的杂气后，巫未央停下修练，摸了摸咕咕响的肚子，立马跑向厨房。
米面已经不多，看来又要下山一趟了。
content_en:
She was not a daydreamer and immediately opened the book of exercises. The name of this exercise book without attributes was called "Basic Internal Techniques". She found that after learning the Qi Refining Technique, she could understand most of the exercises. The Qi Refining Technique was truly the foundation for getting started.
Wu Weiyang read it several times to make sure he saw nothing wrong, then he fell into trance and started to use his spiritual power according to the description of the technique.
After running the technique, Wu Weiyang did know how to use spiritual power, but this technique really lives up to its name. It just teaches people to use spiritual power roughly, without any gentleness and soothing. Even a novice like Wu Weiyang can feel the simplicity of this technique.
So after she learned it, she no longer planned to read it in depth, and instead studied the sword manual.
The sword manual was exactly what Tang Luotian usually used. Wu Weiyang had seen it thousands of times, but after carefully reading the description of the sword manual, she gained new insights. Since she didn't have a sword, she took the Zhu Xiaozhao sword manual and started practicing slowly one by one.
Two months later, Chen Mo came back.
When he came back, Wu Weiyang was practicing swordplay. Chen Mo was a little surprised to see her decent swordsmanship.
When Wu Weiyang saw Chen Mo, he couldn't wait to ask, "Master, have senior brothers entered the big sect?"
Chen Mo was interrupted by her and stopped thinking about her swordsmanship. He said with a hint of joy on his eyebrows, "Your senior brother has been able to enter the Qingyun Sect, Miao Miao has gone to the Zitian Sect, and Jing'er has gone to the Qiyan Sect."
Wu Weiyang knew the reputation of these sects. They were the top sects in Hongmeng Continent, but he did not expect that the senior brothers and sisters would go to different sects separately.
In this regard, Chen Mo said that the Qingyun Sect was the best in swordsmanship. Tang Luotian decided to follow the swordsmanship and naturally chose the Qingyun Sect. There were many practitioners in the Zitian Sect, so it was also the best place for Liu Miaomiao to go to the Zitian Sect. Cui Jing's goal from the beginning was the Qiyan Sect.
It doesn't matter whether we separate or not, this is the best way for them.
Wu Weiyang was happy for them.
After telling the news, Chen Mo said to Wu Weiyang, "Now that Chaotian Sect is no longer here, you can stay here if you have nowhere to go, but I have something to do and I'm afraid I won't be back for a long time in the future."
Wu Weiyang had already decided, "Thank you, Master, for taking me in."
Chen Mo could see the stubbornness of the little girl in front of him, shook his head, went to his house to get something, and left.
Wu Weiyang stood in the center of the square, watched him leave, and picked up the bamboo flute again.
Over and over again, as cold comes and summer comes, spring passes and autumn comes, the figure on the square becomes thinner.
Three years have passed by. Wu Weiyang has grown taller and her cultivation level has also improved. Now she has reached the sixth level of Qi refining.
She was really slow in cultivating the Five Spiritual Roots. Even though she worked day and night, she only reached three levels of cultivation in three years.
In fact, her speed is already equivalent to the speed of Sanlinggen.
This is not because her spiritual roots are different from the ordinary five spiritual roots, but that it does not take time for her to enter concentration. Ordinary children who are just starting out do not have the concentration like her to be able to practice endlessly. This makes Wu Weiyang's practice time almost several times longer than others.
However, Wu Weiyang didn't know this. She had no chance to contact other Five Spiritual Root cultivators. She just felt that it was a waste of time to get rid of impurities and delayed her practice.
Wu Weiyang is still thinking about the idea of ​​​​turning the five elements of spiritual energy in the body. He has made many attempts in the past three years, but they all ended in failure.
After once again painstakingly clearing away the impurities in his body, Wu Weiyang stopped practicing, touched his growling stomach, and immediately ran to the kitchen.
There is not much rice and noodles left, and it seems that we have to go down the mountain again.
